$description: 360 Vision Events — evidence-locked design tokens read from the live public site (https://360visionevents.co.za -> 302 -> https://360-vision-events.co.za/). Mode per token: observed | inferred | absent. Audit trail: evidence.json.

color_mode.dark: this token set — the only colour mode the site declares
color_mode.light: absent (no light theme, .dark toggle or prefers-color-scheme rule on the site)

$extensions.name_rule: CSS custom property = '--' + token path with '.' replaced by '-'
value_conventions: number tokens are JSON numbers; cubicBezier tokens are 4-number arrays (tokens.css prints cubic-bezier(...)).

color, dimension, duration, shadow and gradient values are kept as the site's own CSS strings (hex, oklch(), color-mix(), calc(), multi-layer shadows) rather than DTCG composite objects, so no colour space or unit is converted.

var(--x) references are resolved to the observed :root value; $extensions.declared keeps the authored form and $extensions.resolved_vars the substitution. Line-height calc() ratios are evaluated to numbers (declared form kept). Radius steps keep calc() because they mix rem and px.
$extensions.usage_count_rule: Occurrences across the 9 fetched HTML pages of the plain class plus its responsive (sm:/md:/lg:) and file: variants. Interactive-state variants (hover:, focus:, focus-visible:, group-hover:, placeholder:, data-[...]:) are not counted, except for state tokens (hover, focus, ring) and wherever $extensions.note names them.

bg.$description: Page canvas. Body background via --color-background; base of every image scrim.

surface.$description: Raised surface: cards (bg-card), bands, CTA panels, home footer. --surface, --card and --popover share this value.

surface-2.$description: Secondary-button fill (the two form-submit buttons). --surface-2, --secondary and --muted share this value; no element renders it as a page or card surface.

$extensions.note: usage = bg-secondary 2; bg-surface-2 and bg-muted compiled but unused
text-foreground 42 + file:text-foreground 18; body inherits it everywhere; hover:text-foreground 110 is a state variant, not counted

text-muted.$description: Supporting copy, nav links, card bodies, placeholders.

$extensions.note: text-muted-foreground 257; placeholder: 21 and data-[placeholder]: 4 are state variants, not counted

brand.$description: Brand orange: CTA fills, eyebrows/kickers, text links, focus ring. Exactly the flat fill of the logo mark, and the favicon's most frequent exact colour.

$extensions.note: text-primary 254 + bg-primary 39; hover:text-primary 81 and group-hover:text-primary 1 are state variants, not counted

accent.$description: Declared --accent. Identical to color.brand; used only as the outline-button hover fill. The site has no second accent hue.

on-brand.$description: Text/icon colour on brand orange (dark on orange). Also --accent-foreground.

border.$description: Default border colour (set on * in the base layer), white at 12%; the 1px width comes from the border/border-t/border-b/border-y utilities.

input.$description: Form-field and outline-button border: white at 16%.

destructive.$description: Declared error/destructive colour. Compiled utilities exist but no fetched page renders it.

on-destructive.$description: Declared text colour on destructive. Not rendered on any fetched page.

success.$description: No success colour is declared in styles.css or used on any fetched page.

warning.$description: No warning colour is declared in styles.css or used on any fetched page.

info.$description: No info colour is declared in styles.css or used on any fetched page.

clean.$description: Third family set by the custom .font-clean utility (not a theme variable). Used on 6 of 9 hero h1s, some h2/h3s and eyebrows. Loaded from Google Fonts (weights 400;500;600;700).

$extensions.note: 56 wrappers (all also mx-auto max-w-6xl); px-5 occurs 59 times in total, the other 3 are padding on min-h-12 CTA buttons

base.$description: Declared --radius; all rounded-* steps are offsets of it.

lg.$description: rounded-lg (= --radius, 8px): case-study cards, panels, CTA bands.

full.$description: rounded-full: pills, chips, floating button, social icons.

sm.$description: Tailwind shadow and shadow-sm compile to the same value (black 10%) — buttons and inputs.

lift.$description: Brand glow: .card-lift:hover and the floating WhatsApp button (shadow-[var(--shadow-lift)]).

focus-ring.$description: Default focus-visible ring on buttons and fields: ring-1 in --ring, no offset.

$extensions.computed_from: 0 0 0 calc(1px + var(--tw-ring-offset-width)) var(--tw-ring-color) with offset 0 and --ring #ff4000

scrim.$description: Bottom-up canvas scrim: 56 case-card captions and 1 /services image caption.

cta-tint.$description: Orange-tinted CTA band background (primary 14% into surface).

fast.$description: Tailwind default transition duration: colour changes on links and buttons, and the arrow nudge.

$extensions.note: transition-colors 178 + transition-transform without a duration-* class 5
